title: CSCI 605 — Advanced Object-Oriented Programming Concepts
subject: Object-Oriented Programming
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define and distinguish between inheritance and composition as mechanisms for code reuse and object design.
Explain how dynamic method dispatch and encapsulation enforce runtime polymorphism and data integrity.
Apply design patterns and event-driven principles to structure complex, maintainable software systems.
